author: Claude (Cloudreach Meshy generation worker), owner-authorized Meshy use (Standing owner direction 1, 15 Oct 2026)
workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from repo references (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro) -> Meshy multi-image-to-3d (latest, quad remesh, PBR)
target_size_m: 6 x 6 m platform, 9 m tall overall, 3 m struts

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z

concepts.prompt: Small cliff house built on a cantilevered timber-and-stone platform, 6 by 6 metres, 9 metres tall overall, the platform held out over empty space by diagonal 3 metre honey-timber struts braced against a short limestone foundation block. Walls of pale limestone and cream plaster with honey timber framing, steep slate-blue tiled roof, warm amber glowing windows, small wooden railing around the platform edge. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no cast background, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) with clearly stacked horizontal sedimentary strata and soft moss on the ledges; where present, slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66), honey-coloured timber, cream plaster, royal-blue banner fabric with a small gold accent. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat ground contact at the base.

visual_verdict: Fair-good: timber-strut cantilever deck on a limestone pier, tall slate roof, banner. First 3D attempt had a blotchy lumpy roof, rerun at 30k (chosen) is cleaner. Footprint narrow (4.1 x 4.8 m at 9 m); struts brace a stone pier rather than a cliff face, so it must be placed against a cliff edge. Single material.
integration_flag: OFF - candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: no red/oxblood requested or observed; blue banners/roofs only
